title: QA note -- Steenbarger's read of the whole record after ratification, with optional holds (R36 round 6)
x_purpose: One note: did every decider read evidence; are reasons leaning on the same few anchors; did anyone's point go unanswered; does the slate say what the deciders said. He may HOLD a ticket: the Chair reopens the floor on that ticket only, with his question; the deciders discuss once more and ratify again. ONE hold per ticket, then the result stands. He cannot vote or veto.

evidence_read.x_note: one row per decider, every decider once

shared_anchors.x_note: the few fields or phrases many cases lean on; [] when none

holds.x_note: each slate ticket at most once; [] for no hold

x_registrar_extra_checks: with --slate: every held ticker is on the slate
a ticker held twice in one note => REJECT (one hold per ticket, R36)
evidence_read covers exactly the seven deciders
